verification_method: Desktop tested a fresh Files v1 install and v2 update. Mobile first installed v1 and saved Vaduz, then ran the complete cancellation/lock/restart matrix on the v1-to-v2 update. Hardware key/mouse/touch events, actual observations and OCR of guest/composed pixels were used. Development runs finalized documentation/test fingerprints separately; the final auditor requires identical installed/rebuilt loaders and every ELF and verifies all compiled source fingerprints. Only the README and UI harness may differ as noncompiled inputs; executed harness hashes are recorded.
timing_scope: Times start after selected-file preview and cover page source reads, validation, inactive-bank writes/readback, durable publication and loading the displayed map. Fixture provisioning is excluded. Host load and build activity varied; these are diagnostic wall times, not a desktop/mobile hardware comparison.
limits: Prepared NXMRPK02 bundles with an overview, 64 detail pages and bounded whole-region index; arbitrary upstream MWM and continent-scale imports are not implemented.
Fresh 384 MiB public map-disk layout; no migration of installed 192 MiB map disks or personal data.
Encrypted multipart backing parts currently append without reclamation; interrupted test-source provisioning can leave unreachable encrypted parts.
No general external-drive/host file-ingress UI or publisher authentication is added.
Mobile erasure remains the managed Maps/store/picker group and Vault-key lifecycle; broader phone UI/other application RAM limits remain unchanged.

main_integration.scope: Rebased without conflicts onto two newer Wi-Fi commits. The shared Cargo manifest gained a Wi-Fi feature declaration; upstream made no Maps runtime changes. Original UTM evidence and its tested base are retained above; UTM was not rerun after this rebase.
